messages:
morgan: Heads-up — time for our quarterly access review. I pulled a KMS grant snapshot and there are ~120 service identities with cryptoKeyEncrypterDecryptor grants across prod regions. We should do a lightweight canary prune (owner ping -> revoke stale grants) before a bulk sweep. Thoughts? :eyes:

olivia: +1. agree on canary. can we target a small slice (e.g., 8-10 grants) across 2 services and 1 region to validate owner response and telemetry?

sanjay: yep. can we get a list of the service identities and owners? how recent is the last-use telemetry?

morgan: last-use is from our audit index — about 45% haven't used keys in 90+ days. I exported a CSV and put a short subset in the drive: https://rwd-bucket/reports/q_access_q2.csv

kai: for discovery, run something like:```bash
# example: GCP-style listing (adapt to our org)
gcloud kms keys list --location=us-central1 --keyring=redwood-keys --format=json 
# small jq to map bindings to members
```

olivia: I'll take the export and prepare owner pings. my plan: 1) tag owners with a 7-day TTL 2) if no response, create a controlled revoke PR for the canary grants 3) monitor audit-log spikes and app errors for 72h.

sanjay: who will do the revoke PR? we should gate it with a rollout job that can auto-rollback if errors > threshold. also we need a runbook for incident response if a key removal breaks something.

kai: I'll author the revoke playbook and a small telemetry guard. proposal: deploy revokes via a job that annotates the change with an incident ticket field and a two-hour rollback window. rollback steps: reattach grant, restart affected service worker, clear local cache. keep revokes to a max of 10 at once.

audit-bot: New access review snapshot generated: https://audit.internal/reports/3642109876 (72MB). Findings: 118 grants, 53 owners missing in HR mapping, 57 last-used >90d.

morgan: perfect — olivia, can you start owner pings today? sanjay/kai, agree to pair on the PR + rollout job? I'll coordinate with support and oncall so we have a fast escalation channel. target: canary PR by EOD Friday, then 72h observation.

olivia: starting now. will post the owner ping template in #eng-security after drafting. sample ping will include: "please justify KMS grant or request renew by <date>."

sanjay: I'll draft the revoke PR template and the CI job that labels the change and enforces the safety checks.

kai: I'll build the rollback script and the telemetry check (error-rate, tail latency, failed decrypts). plan to alert @oncall if decrypt errors > 0.5% for 10m after change.

morgan: two quick asks: 1) let's ensure we log the exact change in audit-log with the PR id, 2) capture a short post-canary checklist (owner responses, errors, time-to-rollback).

olivia: noted. will include a short spreadsheet for the checklist and owner evidence links.

audit-bot: Reminder scheduled: Access-review owner pings sent at 2026-03-27T15:00Z (automated).

morgan: thanks team. small, deliberate steps — we don't want a noisy outage. ping me if you hit any blockers. :thumbsup:
